detail: Fixed duplicate.csv includes one repeated whole subject row. In a fresh session, the native grade workflow retained a 260-row risk population and produced five downloads. Twenty-one risk counts, ten rounded Cox quantities and three BH-reconstructed log-rank p values matched independent R using the duplicate input. No duplicate warning was visible in the inspected execution. This is a bounded supplied-input response; the outcome-feature leakage component is unexecuted, and universal absence of duplicate safeguards is not inferred. Initial unverified session attempts remain preserved.
